text: THE DBIM DESIGN'S ORGANISATION PAGES CARRY EVERYTHING THE LIVE PAGES DO, AND OPEN NOTHING ON THE LIVE SITE. Ministry › Our Organisation › <body> showed a summary and the older scrape's prose. It now reads each body's page on dosje.gov.in (a dated snapshot, `lib/website-shared/organisation-profiles.ts`, written by `scripts/build-organisation-profiles.mjs`; ten bodies, read 29 Sep 2026) and lays it out in DBIM's detail layout: the body's mark, standing, statement and headline figures beside an On This Page index; then its leadership as Our Team's profile cards, scheme cards, reports as document rows, the Latest Updates tabs, state offices, activity tiles, gallery, social accounts and a contact list whose numbers dial. Every link that named a dosje.gov.in page opens the estate's own copy (`lib/website-dbim/live-links.ts`), served by new DBIM routes under the body — its own pages, document registers, events, gallery, directory and officers' profiles — and Connect › Events › <event>. 291 pages two links out answer; `node tools/dbim-live-links/crawl.mjs` checks it. The Dr. Ambedkar Foundation page, the widest on the live site, was the reference.
